content.text: Morning! I'm based in Halifax, in Atlantic time, so catching you early. Recovering from knee surgery, so I am on half days this week. Let's look at the database retry issue.
Good morning. Hope the knee recovery goes smoothly. What part of the database retry is failing?

In our pipeline service, we see database locked errors under write bursts. In my day job I work as a data platform engineer at a renewable energy consultancy, and we hit similar concurrency walls there. Let's set the SQLite busy_timeout to 5000 milliseconds.
Setting busy_timeout to 5000 milliseconds will give writers time to clear WAL checkpoints before failing. I can update the connection helper.
Sounds good. Also, I edit with Neovim in the kitty terminal, so keep indentation at 4 spaces and no tabs. I need to sign off around 15:00 today because my rescue dog Barnaby has a vet appointment.
Understood. Four-space indentation, no tabs, busy_timeout 5000 ms. Give Barnaby our best at the vet.
